description: A single-panel vertical dot plot comparing calculated and experimental lattice parameters of ordered Fe-Al-Mn-C compounds. The ordinate is labelled "Lattice parameter a0 (Å)" and spans 2.5 to 4.0 with a labelled tick every 0.1 Å; the abscissa carries six compound groups in reading order — FeAl-B2, Fe3Al-L12, Fe3AlC-L1'2, Fe2MnAlC, FeMn2AlC and Mn3AlC — each subdivided into condition columns labelled sp and np, with an additional exp column for FeAl-B2, Fe3AlC-L1'2 and Mn3AlC. DFT results are blue diamonds, experimental values red triangles. Several groups are enclosed in dashed rectangular boxes. The lowest values belong to FeAl-B2: both blue diamonds sit between the 2.8 and 2.9 gridlines below the red triangle, which lies just under 2.9. Fe3Al-L12 diamonds fall between the 3.5 and 3.7 gridlines. Adding C (Fe3AlC-L1'2) raises values into the 3.7-3.8 region, the experimental triangle being the group maximum; the Mn-bearing groups Fe2MnAlC and FeMn2AlC lie near 3.75 Å, and Mn3AlC is highest of all with its triangle at the top, near 3.85 Å. No numeric labels are printed on any marker.

subfigures.description: Grouped vertical dot plot of lattice parameter a0 (Å) on a 2.5-4.0 ordinate against six ordered-compound groups (FeAl-B2, Fe3Al-L12, Fe3AlC-L1'2, Fe2MnAlC, FeMn2AlC, Mn3AlC), each split into sp/np (and where available exp) columns; blue diamonds = calculated, red triangles = experimental, with dashed boxes grouping some sets.

observations.observation: The ordinate is labelled "Lattice parameter a0 (Å)" and is ruled from 2.5 to 4.0 with labelled ticks every 0.1 Å.
Six compound groups appear along the abscissa in reading order: FeAl-B2, Fe3Al-L12, Fe3AlC-L1'2, Fe2MnAlC, FeMn2AlC, Mn3AlC.
Each group contains condition columns labelled "sp" and "np"; an additional "exp" column is present only for FeAl-B2, Fe3AlC-L1'2 and Mn3AlC.
Data are plotted as blue diamonds (two per sp/np group) plus one red triangle in the exp groups, with dashed rectangular boxes drawn around several sets.
For FeAl-B2 the two blue diamonds lie between the 2.8 and 2.9 gridlines and below the red triangle, which sits just under the 2.9 gridline.
The Fe3Al-L12 group has no experimental point; its two blue diamonds fall between the 3.5 and 3.7 gridlines.
In the Fe3AlC-L1'2 group the red experimental triangle is the highest marker of that group, close to the 3.8 gridline, above both blue diamonds.
Mn3AlC holds the highest lattice parameters in the figure, with its red triangle at the top of the plot near the 3.85-3.9 region and blue diamonds between 3.8 and 3.85.
No numeric data labels are printed on any marker; values can only be bracketed against the 0.1 Å gridlines.
The caption states that experimental values are indicated by red triangles (the blue diamonds being the calculated ones).
The caption lists the compounds plotted as FeAl-B2, Fe3Al-L12, Fe3AlC-L1'2, Fe2MnAlC, FeMn2AlC and Mn3AlC.

The citing text reports that the calculated lattice parameter of ordered FeAl-B2, with (sp) or without (np) spin effects, was slightly less than the experimental value but still in good agreement with reported experiments.
The citing text reports that the lattice constant calculated for Fe3AlC is larger than that of Fe3Al-L12, attributed to expansion caused by the C atom occupying the octahedral interstitial site.
The citing text states that substituting Fe by Mn increases the lattice parameter from 3.78 Å for Fe2MnAlC to 3.84 Å for the Mn3AlC phase.
The citing text attributes the Mn-induced expansion to the larger atomic radius of Mn (rMn = 1.61 Å) compared with Fe (rFe = 1.56 Å).
